description: How long a pairing code has left, rendered for a person: whole seconds until the relay's own expires_at, and m:ss. Presentation, per shell, because the deadline itself is Rust's — await_pairing rebuilds its poll schedule from the same timestamp and is the only thing that ends a wait.
note: PARTIAL (test-reduction lever C, 2026-09-24): the TS (pairingCountdown.test.ts) and Swift (formerly PairingCodeTests.swift's PairingCountdownTests suite) copies were dropped as per-shell replays of the same inputs; Kotlin's PairingCountdownTest.kt is now the one asserted suite for this concept. All three read an unparseable timestamp as no time left, deliberately — a code shown as spent is the safe way to be wrong. Still no shared fixture, so a change to the rule must land in all three production copies by hand; only the test is consolidated.
